results.query: CPUC General Order 167-C energy storage system maintenance operation standards
results.snippet: Resolution ESRB-13, adopted March 13, 2025, establishes GO 167-C to expand maintenance and operation standards to energy storage systems and updates safety and emergency planning requirements for all electric generating facilities and energy storage systems.
